task.title: naturalday and naturaldate accept ISO 8601 strings
task.body:
Why: https://github.com/python-humanize/humanize/issues/129 ; src/humanize/time.py naturalday and naturaldate treat a str as not date-ish and return it unchanged, so a template that holds an ISO 8601 text must parse it first.
Outcome: `humanize.naturalday(value)` and `humanize.naturaldate(value)` accept an ISO 8601 string in addition to date and datetime: a string that `datetime.date.fromisoformat` or `datetime.datetime.fromisoformat` parses is converted to that object and then formatted exactly as the object would be. With today 2026-11-14: `naturalday("2026-11-13") == 'yesterday'`, `naturalday("2026-11-15T09:30:00") == 'tomorrow'`, `naturalday("2026-11-14T23:59:59+00:00") == 'today'`, `naturalday("2026-11-10", format="%d.%m") == '10.11'`, `naturaldate("2026-11-13") == 'yesterday'`, `naturaldate("2025-01-02") == 'Jan 02 2025'`. A string that is not ISO 8601 is returned unchanged: `naturalday("hello") == 'hello'`, `naturaldate("hello") == 'hello'`, `naturalday("") == ''`. date and datetime input is unchanged.
Proof: add tests to tests/test_time.py using freeze_time.

With today 2026-11-14: `naturalday("2026-11-13") == 'yesterday'`, `naturalday("2026-11-15T09:30:00") == 'tomorrow'`, `naturalday("2026-11-14T23:59:59+00:00") == 'today'`, `naturalday("2026-11-10", format="%d.%m") == '10.11'`, `naturaldate("2026-11-13") == 'yesterday'`, `naturaldate("2025-01-02") == 'Jan 02 2025'`. A string that is not ISO 8601 is returned unchanged: `naturalday("hello") == 'hello'`, `naturaldate("hello") == 'hello'`, `naturalday("") == ''`. date and datetime input is unchanged.
install: python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/python -m pip install -q babel -e '.[tests]' && .venv/bin/pybabel --quiet compile --directory src/humanize/locale --domain humanize
